content.text: A single locked-off first-person shot of the military clerk seated at this desk, exactly matching the supplied first frame: same face, clothes, pose, lighting and location. Only this one man remains in the frame throughout. His arms stay resting in their starting position. He looks toward the camera and speaks Mandarin naturally, once: “直接交案，也会把缺粮和欺瞒分开查。没征来的粮，按欠缺查。” Then his lips close. Keep the original composition for the entire shot, with subtle breathing and small eye movements. No other person enters, no new objects enter, no cuts, no camera movement, no subtitles, no music. Soft tent ambience only apart from the specified dialogue.
